recipes.title: Glowing Spiced Lentil Soup

ingredients.item: fine sea salt, or to taste

steps: Warm the oil in a large pot and soften the diced onion. Add the garlic and spices; stir briefly until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes, coconut milk and broth, then add the rinsed lentils, salt, pepper and optional heat. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer for about 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then add the lime juice. Taste and adjust seasoning.
recipes.notes: For an optional oil-free variation, soften the onion with water or broth instead of the olive oil. The original full-fat coconut milk gives a richer result; keep it as written unless choosing a separate variation.

recipes.title: Tofu bacon bits

ingredients.item: extra-firm tofu, drained (no need to press it)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 180°C and prepare a baking sheet.
Combine the seasonings in a bowl, then crumble in the tofu and toss until coated.
Spread the bits on the sheet. Bake for 30–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crisp and brown; watch closely near the end.
Cool completely before storing in an airtight container in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Source yield: 24 one-tablespoon servings (about 1½ cups). Quantities and recipe-card prep/cook times verified from the source; method paraphrased.

recipes.title: Go-to Neapolitan pizza dough
steps: Mix water + yeast + honey; mix in flour.
Leave the poolish for 1 hour at room temp, then put it in the fridge overnight.
Mix all the poolish in water, add half the flour, add salt, then the remaining flour; knead.
Rest covered for 15 min on the bench.
Oil hands, lift and fold the sides under a few times.
Place in a bowl (oil if needed), rest 30 min.
Make dough balls and rest 2 hours at room temp.
recipes.notes: The poolish uses its own ingredients; 'all poolish' in the main dough refers to the prepared batch, not an extra ingredient. No pizza-ball count or baking time was supplied.

recipes.title: Rice paper bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F / about 204°C and line a baking tray.
Whisk everything except the rice paper together for the marinade.
Dip three sheets briefly in water, stack them, let them stick together, then cut into strips.
Coat the strips in marinade and spread them on the tray. Repeat with the other three sheets.
Bake for about 8–10 minutes, until browned and bubbling. Let cool before serving.
recipes.notes: For crispier strips stack fewer sheets; use more for a chewier texture. Store airtight in the fridge for a few days and re-crisp in a pan if they soften.

recipes.title: Boller med dadler og bønner

ingredients.item: hvite bønner, 230 g avrent og godt skylt

steps: Ha dadler og hvite bønner i food processor sammen med melken og kjør til en helt glatt puré (ingen biter – dette er viktig for luftighet).
Ha mel, tørrgjær, kardemomme og salt i bakebolle.
Tilsett egg og puréen av daddel/bønner/melk.
Elt på lav hastighet i 8–10 minutter.
Ha i smøret i terninger, litt etter litt.
Øk til medium hastighet og elt videre i 10–15 minutter (siste 3–4 min på litt høyere hastighet om maskinen tåler det).
Deigen er ferdig når du kan dra en tynn hinne mellom fingrene uten at den ryker. Deigen skal være blank, smidig og slippe bollen.
Dekk til bollen og hev i 1–1½ time, til ca. dobbel størrelse.
Trill ca 20 boller og legg på et paprikledd stekebrett, eller bake- og stekematte som jeg bruker her.
Dekk med kjøkkenhåndkle og etterhev i 45–60 minutter.
Pensle med egg og stek på 220 grader i ca 12 minutter, til de er gylne.
recipes.notes: Ekstra egg til pensling. 'paprikledd' er beholdt fra kilden (mulig skrivefeil).

recipes.title: Kokospirater
steps: Add dates, water, salt to food processor; blitz smooth, scraping down sides as necessary.
Transfer mixture to medium bowl and add toasted coconut; stir to combine.
Roll mixture into twelve equal balls.
Flatten balls on parchment-lined baking sheet with bottom of a glass.
Use a straw to poke a hole in center of each cookie.
Freeze tray at least one hour.
Melt chocolate in heat-proof bowl over small saucepan with 1 inch simmering water.
Dip cookie bottoms in melted chocolate and return to parchment.
Drizzle remaining chocolate over tops.
Refrigerate to harden at least one hour.
Store refrigerated in airtight container.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Banana Macaroons
steps: Peel and mash the very ripe bananas, then mix in the coconut until combined.
Scoop heaped tablespoon portions, roll firmly into balls, and flatten slightly.
Bake at 350°F / 180°C for about 15 minutes, until just turning golden. Let cool.
Melt the chocolate, dip each macaroon, then leave on baking paper until set.
recipes.notes: Makes 16. For a raw version, dehydrate for 6 hours at 110°F, flip, then dehydrate 4 hours more; coat with raw chocolate. Store chilled and enjoy within 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months.
